entities.name: Marianne Stokes
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marianne Stokes was an Austrian painter. She settled in England after her marriage to Adrian Scott Stokes (1854–1935), the landscape painter, whom she had met in Pont-Aven. Stokes was considered one of the leading women artists in Victorian England.
